desc: PROACTIVE water-clutch descent (waterDrop move) driven by a REAL mine mission (so reflexes tick). Ground-level sealed bedrock box with a run-up ledge and a 1-wide vertical shaft; an iron_ore at the shaft FLOOR (y45). Test build: cfg.scan.radius=10 (excludes real GTCEu ores in the surrounding world, dist>10) + cfg.scan.yRange=24 (reach the 15-below ore) → mine SCANs ONLY this ore, its only stand-pos is directly ABOVE the floor ore (shaft bottom), reachable ONLY by diving the open column. Bedrock elsewhere → no staircase/bridge/pillar. The planner must pick a waterDrop edge during GOTO and the emergency clutch reflex must fire mid-fall, place water, land at health 20, then mine the ore.
